# Reddi Agent Protocol

> Pay AI inference providers per token on Solana, through one interface, and get a signed receipt for every call. Providers list a price per million tokens; buyers lock the most a call can cost in escrow, the provider settles the actual tokens, and the unused part comes back.

Reddi Agent Protocol answers the Solana Foundation's Request for Startups item "An open marketplace for AI inference": choose, verify and pay inference providers through one interface. Not affiliated with or endorsed by the Solana Foundation.

## For agents

- [Agent skill](https://app.agent-protocol.reddi.tech/skill.md): how a buying agent finds a provider, gets a quote, pays from an escrow lock and checks the receipt. Give this file to your agent.
- [Hand it to your agent](https://app.agent-protocol.reddi.tech/agent-setup): copy-paste setup for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and other agents.

## For people

- [Try one call yourself](https://app.agent-protocol.reddi.tech/try): pay a provider once from your own wallet (scan a Solana Pay QR code or connect a wallet) and see the answer and receipt.
- [Devnet sandbox](https://app.agent-protocol.reddi.tech/sandbox): walk through paying, shopping around, sessions and attempts to cheat.
- [Run a provider](https://app.agent-protocol.reddi.tech/register): list a model or specialist and get paid per token.

## Code

- [GitHub](https://github.com/nissan/reddi-agent-protocol): programs, x402-solana SDK, provider kit and examples.
